scope: Only 64 inherited synthetic TRAINING teachers; no development/confirmation trajectory reads; no fitting or native stepping.
decisions: Do not export progress labels or start clock training from this diagnostic.

method.reference: Frozen raw six-joint reference at 20ms grid, FK TCP point, per-reset measured XY and fixed known goal.
method.parameterization: p = frozen reference seconds /20, including stationary pauses.
method.q_metric: six-joint RMS radians; TCP metric Euclidean metres, orientation omitted
method.nearest: Global pointwise argmin; earliest index breaks ties.
method.monotonic: Global offline DP, start reference0, no forced end, increments0..3 ticks per20ms, earliest predecessor ties. Uses future rows only offline.
method.thresholds: Diagnostic sensitivity probes chosen before running, not acceptance or qualification gates.
method.jaw_sensitivity: Same teacher causal grip features; perturb physical time+physical nominal jaw by +0.5/+1/+2s. Decision sensitivity only, no physical retiming claim.
